thread:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout 2026-03-17T10:13:09Z — error rate spike >6% on model-serving-canary in eu-west-1. Auto-canary-fallback triggered? no.
incident-bot: @anika you are oncall — paging for canary failure (severity: high). Incident ticket: INC-5421.
anika: ack. I'm looking. Can we confirm scope? which pods are showing errors?
matt: logs show 500s from transformer-worker-3/5. Stacktrace points at KV cache miss leading to OOM in that pod.
sara: seeing increased tail latency too, p50->p95 jump. Traffic to canary is ~3% of traffic but errors correlate with retry storms from edge.
lee: customer impact: small but growing — 12 customers saw noisy errors in EU region, support ticket count rising. No PII exposed.
anika: ok, start manual mitigation plan: 1) drain canary, 2) flip runtime flag to disable new routing, 3) if errors persist, rollback canary image. Matt/Sara please run steps and call out when done.
matt: running drain now: `kubectl patch svc model-serving --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/traffic","value":{"canary":0}}]'`
qa-bot: smoke tests queued against primary variant, expect ~2m.
sara: flipping runtime flag `routing.new_canary` -> false via /ops/flags API: `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" https://flags.internal/flip -d '{"feature":"routing.new_canary","value":false}'`
matt: drain applied, canary pod count -> 0. Monitoring errors.
anika: watch logs for retry loops, disable client-side retries if possible — edge team? @lee can we notify edge?
lee: pinged edge oncall. They've paused aggressive retries for eu-west.
incident-bot: INC-5421 updated: mitigation steps in progress, page status -> acknowledged.
qa-bot: smoke tests: all checks green on primary variant (connectivity, inference sanity).
sara: errors dropping to baseline. p95 latency slowly returning.
anika: hold on rollback. Since drain+flag fixed it, we don't need image revert. We'll keep canary at 0% and re-run stress tests.
matt: capturing a snapshot for root cause: memory growth pattern in transformer-worker-3. Dump saved at s3://redwood-inference/diag/INC-5421/dump-2923456789.tgz
anika: nice. @all — please update INC-5421 with links to logs, dump, customer tickets. I'll run a postmortem template after stabilization.
lee: informing affected customers with status update now.
incident-bot: oncall handoff reminder — anika is oncall for next 2h. If anything spikes, escalate to matt/sara.
anika: thanks. Closing this coordination thread; will keep ticket open for RCA and follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
